card.title: PlayStation 5 Fan not working

claims.statement: PS5 fan not spinning: try a new fan first (common failure), then check the fan FPC (often ripped) and its diode readings; 12 V must be present if the console turns on.

The fan PWM signal comes straight from the southbridge (CXD90061GG or CXD90069GG); no reading means a PCB crack, a bad ball under the southbridge, or a failed southbridge; a short means replace the southbridge.
Replacement southbridges must match type (61GG vs 69GG); remove the CMOS battery and preheat when replacing.

procedure: Replace southbridge (matching type) if PWM shorted/open.
card.caveats: Community-written Repair Wiki page, paraphrased; check the linked page (and its images) before acting on a reading.
